text:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding tenant 'Aurora Labs' in eu-north-4. They need P5 and G5 capacity for inference tests and we hit ENI/accelerator ceilings in prior onboards. Can we raise quotas now?

sanjay: Which account? exact accel types + numbers?

maria: account 123456789012, want p5: 8 -> 16, g5: 16 -> 32, also ENI quota increase to 500 (was 250). timeline: next week.

lucas: noted. adding request details to AWS case. Are we also requesting EC2 instance vCPU quotas? last time they hit 'NetworkInterfaceLimit' and IP exhaustion.

kai: Also request 'ElasticNetworkInterfaces' and 'Private IPv4 addresses per ENI' increase. For p5/p4d we should ask for ENI throughput bump and eni-per-subnet. Suggest: ENIs 500, PrivateIPs-per-ENI 50, security group rules 5000.

sanjay: I'll open the request. We're going to argue for 'accelerator' + 'eni' due to multi-pod inference. Drafting case now.

sanjay: ```
AWS Support case draft:
- Account: 123456789012
- Region: eu-north-4
- Quotas to increase: 
    AcceleratorCount (p5 family) -> 16
    AcceleratorCount (g5 family) -> 32
    Network Interfaces (per region) -> 500
    Private IPv4 addresses per ENI -> 50
- Reason: Dedicated tenant onboarding for low-latency inference with sustained KV/streaming traffic. Multi-instance pods require deterministic ENI availability.
```

maria: tagging @cloud-finance — this will increase monthly spend. Can we get an estimate?

lucas: quick calc: p5 on-demand is rough — ballpark incremental ~ $60k/mo if fully on-demand. With committed reserved for pilot we should target ~30% discount, so plan for ~$40k/mo. Finalize after exact SKU selection.

kai: FYI last onboard we hit ENI throttling causing attach failures and packet drops — attach log snippet:
```
[2026-03-10 14:23:02] ENI throttle: RateExceeded -> attach failure count 37 in 1m
```

ops-bot: Created AWS support case 1234567890. Expected reply 48-72h. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/1234567890 

aws-support-bot: AWS replied: need justification for peak sustained usage, network topology diagram, and expected IP-per-instance. Please upload diagrams + load profile.

maria: uploading topology + expected RPS + load tests to the case in ~45m. Also can we enable fallback routing to eu-west-3 in case AWS rejects?

sanjay: yes — plan B: spin up 8 g5s in eu-west-3, mark them as fallback in the smart-router config and use automatic DNS weight shift. I put a todo on the onboarding runbook.

lucas: thanks — keep me posted. I'll follow up with finance after we get AWS reply.
